en: Colorized view from a hillside clock tower overlooking a European city with dense historic buildings and a river. The prominent structure on the left is a tall white tower with a steep shingled roof and a large round clock face with Roman numerals and ornate hands. Below the tower is a path and greenery, while the right side shows the sprawling old town, bridges, and the river in the distance. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
